# Clementine Ainslie

- **Age:** 25  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P17](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0017)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P52](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0052), [v5 CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE P10](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Clementine Ainslie is a pretty and light-complexioned woman who is imposing in height and maintains a serene demeanor. She has an exquisitely formed countenance featuring a lofty pale brow, pink cheeks, and an appearance that seems youthful for her age. Her hair is blonde and shines with a warm gold hue, likened to the shade of fresh molasses taffy, which she wears fastened in smooth, tight braids. Her striking features include enormous, beautiful, and serene blue eyes that constantly appear to brim with goodwill, accompanied by a gentle, unhurried smile.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P52](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0052), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. ## History

Clementine Ainslie's father died when she was three years old, and in her youth, she owned a pet hen and lost a young brother. At age seventeen, she exchanged vows of love with her fiancé, [Martin Crawford](../character/martin-crawford.md), eighteen years prior to his death in a shipwreck. Following her mother's death, Clementine remained mostly at home and was persuaded by her sister, [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), to swear a solemn oath on the Bible that neither of them would ever marry. Years later, [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) met Clementine in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), walked her home, and eventually proposed marriage to her. Though bound by her vow to [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), Clementine asked Ashdown for time to consider, but after [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) refused to release her from the oath, Clementine sent him a cold written rejection that left them both heartbroken. When [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) later confronted Clementine, she willingly granted his request to release [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) from her vow so her sister could marry. After Ashdown's daughter [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) visited Clementine to ask her to marry her father, Clementine sent a letter back to Ashdown.

## Quotes

> "You fashioned it with such skill. I have not witnessed a person craft a birch cup in that manner since my young brother was accustomed to making them many years in the past—prior to his death."
>
> — Clementine Ainslie — [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P15](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0015)

> "Discussing things provides so much relief. I am aware of that. I doubt I am capable of understanding as well as Mrs. Carrow—yet I assure you I will not laugh."
>
> — Clementine Ainslie — [v5 CHAPTER XX. GRACE MAKES A FRIEND P14](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0014)

> "However, I would have behaved just as badly, Grace—I wouldn’t have informed him that they were burning—and I do not think I would have ever felt the slightest remorse for my bad behavior, either."
>
> — Clementine Ainslie — [v5 CHAPTER XX. GRACE MAKES A FRIEND P28](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0028)

> "My dear, should a minister fail to act like a gentleman, we have no obligation to honor his coat-tails. I am certain I would have simply adored watching Jimmy Perry’s coat-tails catch fire. That had to be entertaining."
>
> — Clementine Ainslie — [v5 CHAPTER XX. GRACE MAKES A FRIEND P30](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0030)

> "At no time. He holds me in contempt—and with good reason. Say nothing further about it, Harriet. I hold no resentment toward you—choose anyone you wish for a husband. However, do not interfere with my business."
>
> — Clementine Ainslie — [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P33](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0033)

### [Grace](../character/grace.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/clementine-ainslie--grace.md)

Clementine and [Grace](../character/grace.md) established a friendship after sharing confidences. When [Grace](../character/grace.md) was grieving the loss of her rooster, Clementine met her in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), listened sympathetically, and comforted her by offering her a pet canary. [Grace](../character/grace.md) afterwards expressed deep affection for Clementine to her family.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XX. GRACE MAKES A FRIEND P0](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XX. GRACE MAKES A FRIEND P3](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XX. GRACE MAKES A FRIEND P17](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0017), +2 more_

### [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/clementine-ainslie--harriet-ainslie.md)

[Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) is Clementine's sister, with whom she lives and hosts guests. Their relationship is severely strained by a past vow [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) forced Clementine to make on a Bible never to marry or abandon her. When [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) proposed, [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) steadfastly refused to release Clementine from her vow, compelling a heartbroken Clementine to send him a cold rejection.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P50](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0050), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), +24 more_

### [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/clementine-ainslie--john-ashdown.md)

Clementine and [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) share a deep mutual affection, with Clementine being the only woman he loves. After spending warm moments together in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) and visiting her home, Ashdown eventually asked her to marry him. Though she cared for him, Clementine hesitated and ultimately sent him a written rejection due to a binding vow she had made to her sister, leaving both of them heartbroken.
